title: quinoa chard egg bites
ingredients: 1 1/2 Cups shredded or finely chopped chard, or spinach
3 cups cooked quinoa; cooked in broth
(optional) splash of milk; if needed to loosen the mixture
instructions: Line a muffin pan with silicone or parchment muffin liners
In a large mixing bowl, lightly whisk the eggs with a fork.
Add the shredded cheese, salt, cooked quinoa, minced garlic, and chard or spinach.
Stir until everything is evenly combined.
If the mixture looks dry, add a small splash of milk and stir again.
Divide the mixture evenly among the prepared muffin molds.
Bake for 21 minutes, or until the egg muffins are set.
notes: The muffins will stick to a plain greased muffin pan, so silicone or parchment liners are needed. For meal prep, cook the quinoa in advance in Better Than Bouillon broth and freeze it in 1-cup Souper Cubes portions. If using frozen quinoa, microwave it for 2 to 3 minutes, or until thawed enough to break apart, before adding it to the mixture.
